payload.description: One low compact mound of tiny BONE FRAGMENTS and BONE SHARDS for a dark fantasy pixel game. The bones are all snapped into small unequal pieces: short jagged tubular ends, thin pointed splinters, flat curved flakes and tiny joint chips. Mostly stubby and irregular. About 18 small fragments, close together and overlapping. The heap is a low irregular oval, about 40 pixels wide and 22 pixels high. Every individual fragment is only 3-7 pixels long. NO whole bones. NO large dog-bone silhouettes. NO skull or recognizable skeleton. Clearly dry dirty ivory bone material, not round rocks. Each image should be a different irregular arrangement with varied bone shapes. Simple crisp low-resolution pixel art, sparse flat shading, selective dark outline. Top-down three-quarter camera, top-left light. Transparent empty margins, no ground, tray, tile, floor or shadow halo.

target_palette.name: muted ivory bone and gray purple shadow
